render_focused_task_context.title: Render focused task context
render_focused_task_context.purpose: Render a bounded task brief with explicit first steps, acceptance criteria and digest-bound structured state.
render_focused_task_context.limits: Produces text and structured data only. The caller decides native file placement; quoting is a trust cue, not a prompt-injection security guarantee.
dependencies: Python>=3.10 standard library; no third-party packages
render_focused_task_context.methodinterface: JSON on stdin, JSON on stdout; exit 0 success, exit 2 invalid_input

evaluate_capability_requirements.title: Evaluate declared capability requirements
evaluate_capability_requirements.purpose: Compare required and optional capabilities with supplied resolution and evidence levels without granting execution authority.
evaluate_capability_requirements.limits: Evaluates supplied claims; does not authenticate observations, approve an engine, negotiate a protocol or enforce permissions.
dependencies: Python>=3.10 standard library; no third-party packages
evaluate_capability_requirements.methodinterface: JSON on stdin, JSON on stdout; exit 0 success, exit 2 invalid_input

select_context_blocks.title: Select context blocks within a declared budget
select_context_blocks.purpose: Preserve mandatory context and dependencies, then greedily admit optional blocks by explicit priority within supplied costs.
select_context_blocks.limits: Costs are supplied measurements or estimates; this tool does not tokenize a model request, guarantee context fit, optimize a knapsack or grant authority. It refuses any cycle or missing dependency, including in omitted blocks.
dependencies: Python>=3.10 standard library; no third-party packages
select_context_blocks.methodinterface: JSON on stdin, JSON on stdout; exit 0 success, exit 2 invalid_input

paired_sign_test.title: Compute an exact paired sign test
paired_sign_test.purpose: Compare candidate b against baseline a on paired bounded decimal measurements, with explicit ties, missing values and exact two-sided probability.
paired_sign_test.limits: Assumes meaningful paired observations and an equiprobable sign null on non-ties. It does not establish independence, sampling validity, effect size, multiple-comparison correction, task acceptance or a better engine.
dependencies: Python>=3.10 standard library; no third-party packages
paired_sign_test.methodinterface: JSON on stdin, JSON on stdout; exit 0 success, exit 2 invalid_input
